sourceDescription: Indicative PSA boundaries as of June 2016, based on 2015 census mapping
finding: The northern red-box vicinity is in the Binaobao reference polygon; Suba Barangay Hall and Saint Paul Academy are in the Suba reference polygon. Basemap place names are independent of these boundaries.
comparison: Unique vertices match at six decimal places; ring starting point/winding and duplicated closure are ignored. Maximum nearest-vertex difference is approximately 0.078m.
